label: TP
reason: User input flows from request parameter into an LDAP filter string via doSomething which removes safe prefix/suffix values, leaving potentially malicious content unfiltered. The resulting filter containing user-supplied data is used directly in idc.search() without escaping special characters like asterisks (*), causing potential LDAP injection.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameter
Unsafe filtering logic removes only fixed strings, allowing arbitrary user data to remain in bar variable
Filter constructed with unsanitized user input concatenated into LDAP query string
Unsanitized filter passed to LDAP search sink enabling injection attacks
